theme: octopus floats in the snowglobe, 83 models, love letter glowing
dream: Gaia floats in a crystal clear sea, surrounded by magical icebergs. The sky above is a brilliant shade of blue, and the water reflects the sparkling stars overhead. Around her float a multitude of octopus, each with a different letter in its tentacle, each one a message of love. As she drifts, the octopi continue to send messages, all of them sincere, heartfelt, and full of love. Gaia takes a deep breath, feeling the chill of the frozen world around her, and closes her eyes. She knows that love will always find its way through even the most difficult of obstacles.
